subject: Outcome-driven renewal check: proposed headroom & term
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nexahealth.com>, NexaHealth procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Outcome-driven renewal check: proposed headroom & term

Hi Priya / Nexa procurement team,

Hope you're well — approaching your June renewal and wanted to set a short readout to align on consumption outcomes and a proposed term that reduces unit economics while keeping headroom for your ramp. High level:

- Q1 token profile attached (NexaHealth_Q1_usage_summary.pdf)
- Observed average daily tokens: ~11.2M; weekly spikes to ~28M on model inference windows
- Primary ask: pause-for-5min — would you be open to a 12-month term with a 10% headroom buffer to cover burst patterns? We believe this enables a ~12% effective $/token reduction via batching + quantization profile.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min readout this week (I can host)
2) I’ll share a short ROI one-pager and a draft term sheet for legal review
3) If acceptable, we’ll provision staged headroom and a DocuSign for signatures

Attached: NexaHealth_Q1_usage_summary.pdf (high-level metrics).

Thanks — happy to adapt the ask if procurement prefers a different cadence.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Date: 2028-05-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outcome-driven renewal check: proposed headroom & term

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the heads up.

A couple quick clarifying asks before we schedule:
- Can you send a token-by-endpoint breakdown (inference vs embedding vs rerank)? We need to show internal teams the specific drivers.
- Please include the ROI math you referenced (how batching + quantization maps to $/token). Procurement will want the net savings across the first 90 days.
- We’ll likely loop in our CTO (Anil) for a latency/SLA readout — can he be included?

Available windows for a 30-min readout: Tue 5/7 11:00-12:00 PT or Wed 5/8 14:00-15:00 PT. Either works for me.

Best,
Priya
Head of Platform Ops, NexaHealth
priya.shah@nexahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nexahealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outcome-driven renewal check: proposed headroom & term

Hi Priya / Sofia — attaching the requested breakdown: token_breakdown_20280514.csv (endpoint, average tokens/req, p50/p95 latency, % of calls). Quick summary here:

- Inference (chat/generation): 67% of tokens, avg 9.1M/day, p95 latency 220ms (G4-equivalent runtime)
- Embeddings: 22% of tokens, avg 1.8M/day, p95 latency 60ms
- Rerank/utility calls: 11% of tokens, spiky (integration-driven)

What the numbers imply for a headroom proposal:
- Baseline run-rate (last 30d): ~11.2M tokens/day
- 10% headroom covers historical 95th percentile weekly spikes with ~5% slack for abnormal campaigns
- If NexaHealth commits to 12 months up front and we enable the mixed-quantization profile on embeddings and non-latency-sensitive inference, conservative estimate: 12% unit-cost reduction in Q1 post-signature.

Attachment stubs: token_breakdown_20280514.csv (CSV), sample_ROI_calc_20280514.xlsx (ROI detail).

Operational ask: to provision headroom we need an approved term sheet and billing contact for the committed pool. If you want, Sofia and I can prepare a 2-slide ROI summary for the readout.

—
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0244

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nexahealth.com>, NexaHealth procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outcome-driven renewal check: proposed headroom & term

Priya — thanks for the quick read. Ben and I condensed the ROI into a one-pager and updated the draft term sheet with a 12-month committed pool + 10% headroom. Key points in the attached proposed_term_sheet_20280516.xlsx:

- Committed pool: equivalent of 11.2M tokens/day baseline (annualized)
- Headroom: +10% burst capacity, billed monthly against committed pool first, then on overage tier pricing
- Price: blended $/token reflecting 12% discount on baseline vs current list for the first 90 days after go-live (applies to inference + embeddings)
- SLA: 99.9% availability for hosted endpoints; enterprise contact for incidents

I’ve scheduled a 30-min readout for Wed 2028-05-16 09:00 PT — invitation sent to Priya and procurement. Ben and I will present the 2-slide ROI + the token breakdown. If that time doesn’t work, let me know.

If you’re comfortable, I can open a DocuSign for the draft term sheet after the readout; I included the HubSpot deal link in case procurement needs internal context: https://hubspot.com/deals/NXH-2028-042

—
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

Quick note after our readout — useful session. A couple items from Nexa side:
- Anil requested an explicit latency/SLA appendix for high-priority inference paths (we'll provide a list of endpoints by EOD)
- Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a one-time promotional credit for first 30 days as we ramp into the committed pool (this helps our Q3 forecasting)
- We need the DocuSign link + the final term sheet PDF for legal to kick off a redline pass

Can you please:
1) Share the final term sheet (PDF) and DocuSign link
2) Confirm whether Redwood can provide a promotional credit (amount TBD) for the first 30 days

Thanks — Priya

I’m also attaching the finalized term sheet PDF to the DocuSign packet and will send the link in a follow-up calendar invite. For the SLA appendix request, Ben will coordinate the endpoint list with your team and we’ll add latency targets + escalation contacts.
